description: This file defines HTTP handlers for the Mattermost server API v4, including various endpoint configurations with different access requirements and options.

methods.name: APIHandler
methods.description: Creates an HTTP handler for API endpoints that do not require user login.

methods.name: APISessionRequired
methods.description: Creates an HTTP handler for API endpoints requiring user login.

methods.name: CloudAPIKeyRequired
methods.description: Creates an HTTP handler for webhook endpoints accessing Cloud installations.

methods.name: RemoteClusterTokenRequired
methods.description: Creates an HTTP handler for remote cluster requests.

methods.name: APISessionRequiredMfa
methods.description: Creates an HTTP handler for API endpoints requiring login but with MFA considerations.

methods.name: APIHandlerTrustRequester
methods.description: Creates an HTTP handler for endpoints that do not require login and can be requested directly.

methods.name: APISessionRequiredTrustRequester
methods.description: Creates an HTTP handler for endpoints requiring login and direct request permission.

methods.name: APISessionRequiredDisableWhenBusy
methods.description: Creates an HTTP handler that responds with 503 when server is busy.

methods.name: APILocal
methods.description: Creates an HTTP handler for local mode endpoints via UNIX socket.

methods.name: RateLimitedHandler
methods.description: Wraps an API handler with rate limiting based on settings.
